scope: Second property-specific coordinate QA pass for the four retained Texas tribal casino destinations, focused on the two Naskila holds from pass 1.

records.name: Naskila Casino
records.note: The geocoded casino dataset resolves Naskila Gaming at the exact current 540 State Park Rd 56 address. Current first-party Naskila contact material independently confirms that address, so the older coordinate can be retained as property-specific geometry rather than a nearby photo or generic locality point.

holds.name: Naskila Casino Leggett
holds.note: Current first-party evidence confirms the temporary casino is open at 10314 US 59 N on the future resort site. HAR/Realtor property records independently identify the 10314 address and its approximately 93-acre parcel, while resort reporting also references the broader development at 10450 US-59. This pass still did not surface a sufficiently direct numerical point for the operating temporary casino itself, so no nearby parcel, smoke-shop, rest-area, or future-resort coordinate is substituted.

evidenceNotes: Naskila Casino Leggett first-party page: https://www.naskila.com/leggett/
